_description: Simulation parameters for MockProvider and the pure-Python reasoning/recovery nodes. None of these values come from the paper — they are tuning choices for producing realistic-looking benchmark dynamics without real LLM calls.

confidence_distribution._description: Parameters for the mock confidence score drawn by reasoning_node. Models N(base_mu, base_sigma) + N(noise_mu, noise_sigma), clamped to [0, 1]. Chosen so that roughly 30-40% of episodes fall below tau_drift=0.6.

recovery_timing._description: Exponential distribution means (in seconds) for the detect and decide phases. t_execute is governed by reflex_params, not this file. t_execute_min_s is a lower bound so simulated execution times are never negative.

mock_provider_latency._description: Uniform [min, max] sleep ranges (seconds) used by MockProvider when mock_simulate_latency=True. Keys map to the context hint passed to provider.invoke(). An empty string key is the fallback for any unrecognised context.

ttft_fraction._description: MockProvider simulates time-to-first-token as this fraction of the total call duration. 0.20 means the first token arrives when 20% of the simulated call time has elapsed.
